prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R28 remains unmodeled as a distinct requirement: the diagram does not explicitly show that proportional stride scheduling ensures actual resource allocation matches overall job share.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Although the diagram includes stride-related actions, it does not explicitly represent the requirement that the proportional stride-scheduling algorithm is used to ensure actual resource allocation reflects overall job share. The loop only shows time-slicing and pass advancement.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add an explicit action or annotation tying the stride-scheduling loop to enforcing proportional overall share.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R50 remains unmodeled: the system does not show removal of a job from the queue and update of cluster status as part of delete/change job.

prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Connect the delete/change path to a queue-removal and cluster-status update action.
